usage.outputShape: body.image_url (hosted JPG URL); also body.image_description and body.metadata.{model,aspectRatio,replicate_url,cdn_key}
quirks: Body shape is a simple {"prompt":"..."} — NOT the Google Gemini generateContent {contents:[{parts:[{text}]}]} shape. The Gemini shape (from the sibling backend's existingUsage) PAYS and then 400s here with 'prompt is required and must be a non-empty string'.
Output is a hosted image URL at body.image_url (DigitalOcean Spaces CDN .jpg), NOT base64 inline data. Download from that URL to get the image.
Payment settled on Solana, ~$0.15/call, plain synchronous (200 returns the result directly).
This xona-agent.com backend is a different proxy than the x402.orth.sh Gemini backend listed in this service's other usage — do not mix request shapes between them.
usage.guide: POST to https://api.xona-agent.com/image/nano-banana-pro with a JSON body {"prompt":"<your image prompt>"}. Payment is x402 USDC (~$0.15/call, settled on Solana), plain synchronous — a 200 returns the result directly. Read the generated image URL from body.image_url (a hosted .jpg on a CDN) and download it from there. Do NOT use the Google Gemini contents/parts request shape with this URL; it will charge you and then 400.
